For Tourist Visa ONLY. ... if you have any questions in regards to an E-visa application, kindly contact them through their website as the Egyptian consulate doesn't have an access to the portal to assist you.

sources.search_query: official Egypt evisa portal visa2egypt.gov.eg tourist visa
sources.relevant_excerpt: Welcome to Egypt e-Visa Portal ... Sign Up [requires] your email address and some complementary information ... Sign In [to] get access to your pending application(s), or apply for new application ... Apply and pay online [accepting] Visa card, MasterCard or other debit cards ... you will receive an email informing you, with the current application status ... You have to create an e-Visa application at least 7 days before your departure.

sources.search_query: official Egypt evisa portal visa2egypt.gov.eg tourist visa
sources.relevant_excerpt: Single entry visa (Tourism) 30$ ... Multiple entries visa (Tourism) 65$ ... Passport valid for at least 6 months from arrival date. ... Egyptian port authorities have the right to refuse entry to Egypt for an e-visa holder without any explanation. Eligible countries listed on the FAQ: Albania, Argentina, Armenia, Australia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Bahrain, Belarus, Belgium, Bolivia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, China/Taiwan, Colombia, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech, Denmark, Ecuador, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, India, Iraq, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Korea (South), Kuwait, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Malaysia, Malta, Mexico, Moldova, Monaco, Montenegro, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Oman, Paraguay, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Republic of Kosovo, Romania, Russian Federation, San Marino, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Ukraine, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom (England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales), United States of America, Uruguay, Vatican, Venezuela, Vietnam.

sources.search_query: Egypt foreign ministry tourist visa requirements official mfa.gov.eg
sources.relevant_excerpt: Fees: $32 (Single Entry) or $67 (Multiple Entry/ applicant has to provide a ticket reflecting multiple entry into the country) cash. ... Actual passport plus TWO copies of the information page (that has the photo) (valid for at least 6 months on arrival) ... Visa applicants (except the listed nationalities) are advised to get the visa in advance ... Passports holder's who are on list of countries requiring pre-approval cannot acquire visa upon arrival ... Pre-approval list: Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Israel, Mali, Niger, Palestine, Sudan (Sudanese nationals must apply with Sudanese passports only), Syria, Any Travel Document.

sources.search_query: Egyptian consulate London official website tourist visa requirements British citizens
sources.relevant_excerpt: Nationals of the following countries can obtain a visa upon arrival at any of the Egyptian ports of entry: UK, EU members, USA, Australia, Croatia, Georgia, Japan, Canada, New Zealand, Norway, Macedonia, Republic of Korea. ... Single Entry Visas are valid for 6 months and allow a maximum stay of ONLY 30 days in Egypt. ... Multiple Entry Visas are valid for 6 months and allow a collective stay of 90 days in Egypt. ... Nationals of the UK, EU members, and the USA travelling to Sharm El Sheikh, Dahab, Nuweiba and Taba resorts ONLY, for a maximum of 15 DAYS, do not require a visa prior to travelling, as a FREE entry permission stamp will be granted upon arrival. ... Passports of all nationalities must be valid for at least 6 months on the date of issuing the visa. ... Nationals of the following countries: Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Mali, Niger, Syria, Palestine and Israel [need clearance, which] takes at least 8 weeks and may take up to 3 months. Tourist visa fees at this consulate: UK citizens GBP 33 (single) / GBP 68 (multiple).

sources.search_query: Egyptian consulate London official website tourist visa requirements British citizens
sources.relevant_excerpt: Visa fee payable on arrival is 25 US dollars or equivalent in Egyptian pounds. ... Visa on arrival eligible nationalities: UK, EU, Australia, Canada, Croatia, Georgia, Japan, New Zealand, Norway, Macedonia, Republic of Korea, Russian Federation, Serbia, Ukraine, USA. ... Nationals of UK, EU & USA travelling to Sharm El Sheikh, Taba, Dahab and Nuweiba for up to 14 days stay, are visa exempt. ... All passports must be at least 6 months valid before expiry date. ... A multiple-entry visa can only be applied for prior to travelling and valid for the applicant the right to a maximum 90 days stay in Egypt, 6 months, during which the applicant can enter Egypt more than once.

policies.description: Official Electronic Visa Portal for touristic visits for selected countries at www.visa2egypt.gov.eg. Tourist visa only; single-entry USD 30 or multiple-entry USD 65, paid online by credit/debit card. Application must be created at least 7 days before departure. Port authorities retain the right to refuse entry.
conditions: Tourism only
Apply at least 7 days before departure
Passport valid at least 6 months from arrival date
Entry may be refused by port authorities despite visa approval
policies.maximum_stay: 30 days (single entry, per consular description of Egyptian tourist visas); not explicitly stated on the portal pages fetched

policies.description: Nationals of listed countries can obtain a visa upon arrival at any Egyptian port of entry for USD 25 (or equivalent in Egyptian pounds). Single-entry tourist visas allow a maximum stay of 30 days.
conditions: Fee USD 25 or equivalent in Egyptian pounds payable on arrival
Nationalities requiring pre-approval cannot acquire visa upon arrival

policies.description: All nationalities not covered by the eVisa or visa-on-arrival channels must obtain a visa in advance from an Egyptian embassy or consulate. Single Entry Visas are valid for 6 months and allow a maximum stay of ONLY 30 days; Multiple Entry Visas are valid for 6 months and allow a collective stay of 90 days. Nationals of Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Israel, Mali, Niger, Palestine, Sudan, Syria and holders of any travel document require security pre-approval (6-8 weeks minimum, up to 3 months).
conditions: Passport valid at least 6 months
Pre-approval nationalities cannot use visa on arrival
Consular fees vary by post (e.g. USD 32/67 at Washington DC; GBP 33/68 at London)

conditions: Valid only for the Sharm El Sheikh, Dahab, Nuweiba and Taba resort areas; travel beyond them requires a visa

The eVisa maximum stay is not explicitly stated on the fetched portal pages; the 30-day single-entry / 90-day-collective multiple-entry figures come from the Egyptian Consulate London's description of Egyptian tourist visas generally.

The eVisa eligible-country enumeration extracted from the portal FAQ (78 countries listed) may be incomplete; the extraction referenced a larger count. The authoritative list is on https://www.visa2egypt.gov.eg/eVisa/FAQ.

HKG disposition (embassy visa required) is inferred from Hong Kong's absence from the official eVisa and visa-on-arrival lists; no fetched official Egyptian source explicitly addresses HKSAR passports. MAC (Macao) similarly unaddressed and falls under ALL_OTHERS.
Visa-on-arrival eligible list differs slightly between the consulate Visas page and its FAQ (FAQ adds Russian Federation, Serbia, Ukraine); the union was recorded.

Fee variations by channel/post recorded as-is: eVisa USD 30/65, visa on arrival USD 25, Washington DC consular USD 32/67, London consular GBP 33/68. These are per-channel/per-post differences, not necessarily conflicts.
